WITH processing_with_site AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    sp.remaingb,
    (sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) as cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    AVG(remaingb) as avg_remaingb,
    AVG(cpu_gpu_gap) as avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM processing_with_site
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) as mean_remaingb
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  gs.zoneref,
  gs.insurstat,
  gs.avg_remaingb,
  gs.avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
  gs.avg_remaingb / om.mean_remaingb as ratio
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE om.mean_remaingb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
